# Web Page

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/WebPage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A page on the web identified by a URL — a concrete published artifact. A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Web Presence

- **Source:** [`slices/core/documents/examples/web-presence.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/documents/examples/web-presence.ttl)

```turtle
ex:homepage a gmeow:WebPage ;
    gmeow:pageOfSite ex:site ;
    gmeow:embodies ex:siteContent .

# --- The about page: its principal subject is a person, so it IS a ProfilePage
#     (≡ WebPage ⊓ ∃pagePrincipalSubject.Agent) without being typed as one.
ex:aboutMara a gmeow:WebPage ;
    gmeow:pageOfSite ex:site ;
    gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject ex:mara ;
    gmeow:embodies ex:siteContent .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a single web page identified by a URL — the concrete published rendering, member of a [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md) and possibly naming a principal subject.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the whole published collection of pages (use [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md)) and avoid it for the abstract work the page renders (a [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)).

### How to use

- Type the page [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md), link it to its site with [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](../properties/gmeow-pageOfSite.md) and its principal subject with [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md); when that subject is a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) the page is inferred a [`gmeow:ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md).

### Examples

- ex:aboutPage a [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md); [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](../properties/gmeow-pageOfSite.md) ex:site; [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md) ex:lillith.
